mirrorOrOtherProjectWarning: Pictures of this plan (#932-1329): renders 5-9, 13, 17-20, 25, thumbnail 35; drawings 10 (front, cropped), 21-23 (left), 24 (right), 26 (rear, cropped); plans 27-29 (main level) and 30-32 (second level). Captions mislabel the levels: 27-29 'Lower Floor' are titled 'MAIN LEVEL FLOOR PLAN', 30-32 'Main Floor' are titled 'SECOND LEVEL FLOOR PLAN'. Other projects: 1-3 (carousel 453-56, 892-47, 938-119), 4 ('Builder Advantage Home' banner), 11, 12, 14, 15, 16 (#932-179, #932-1250, #932-913, #932-488, #932-622), 33 (farmhouse photo), 34 (photo of #932-216); 36-38 are generic 'Zonda House Plans' detail sheets. No mirrored copy: left/right elevations, renders and both plans agree (entrance door on the right side toward the rear, balcony at the front). Renders use two colour schemes for the upper storey (white in 5-9/13, cream in 17-20/25).

overall.basis: Front = the garage-door gable end (source captions 'Front Elevation' for renders 5-9 and drawing 10; bottom of both plans); the entrance door is on the RIGHT side. Width 23'-0" = 7.0104 m and depth 47'-1" = 14.351 m are printed as text labels on plan 27 (no dimension lines or ticks); they match the drawn main-level rectangle to 0.1% (669 x 1369 px), so they denote the outer faces of the ground storey, which is a plain rectangle including the integral double garage. Framing vs finish face not indicated. The upper storey is shorter (~13.1 m incl. side wing walls, TRACED) with the rooftop balcony over the front ~1.2 m of the ground storey. Published page facts Width 23', Depth 47'1" agree; Height 27'7" = 8.407 m is published (left elevation 22 scaled by 47'-1" gives ~8.46 m grade to ridge, TRACED).

Ridge ~8.46 m above grade and eave ~6.1 m scaled from elevation 22 (TRACED). Flat roof/balcony deck over the front ground-storey strip. No chimney.

uncertain: Printed width/depth are text labels ('width: 23'-0"', 'depth: 47'-1"') without dimension lines; interpreted as outer faces because the drawn main-level rectangle matches them to 0.1%.
Picture captions swap the level names (27-29 'Lower Floor' = drawn 'MAIN LEVEL'; 30-32 'Main Floor' = drawn 'SECOND LEVEL'); ground storey = main level.

Upper-storey setback: glazed front wall ~1.73 m behind the ground-storey front in plan 31; side wing walls and roof end ~1.12 m (plan) / ~1.22 m (elevation 22) behind it; balcony label 23x6 is nominal (traced ~5'-8" to the glazed wall).
Pitch 33.7 deg and ridge/eave heights are TRACED from drawings (consistent with 8:12), not printed; published height 8.407 m vs traced ~8.46 m.
Front and rear elevation drawings exist only as crops (10, 26); lower front and rear openings counted from renders 9/25 and plan 27.
FRONT storey 1 lists the lower row of the glazed gable (large window, French double door, large window) then the three gable panes above, all in the one vaulted storey (no attic floor).
Front gable pane shapes differ between drawing 10 (trapezoids/rectangle) and render 9 (triangles/pentagon).
Front-most lower window on the right side is a two-pane horizontal unit in drawing 24 but looks like a twin casement in render 5; count unaffected.
Labels FLEX SPACE 22x20 / DOUBLE GARAGE 22x22 are nominal interior sizes (flex traced ~24' deep including the stair zone).
Entrance door is ~70% of the way from front to rear on the right side; the stoop outside it is uncovered.
confidence: HIGH - printed overall width/depth on the ground plan agree with the drawing and published facts; both plans, full left/right elevations, cropped front/rear elevations and many renders agree; only pitch/heights and the upper setback are traced.
